descriptions.zh: 联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。
descriptions.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.
